title: Enhanced strength and ductility of laser powder bed fused NbMoTaW refractory high-entropy alloy via carbon microalloying
process_description: prepared by laser powder bed fusion (LPBF) using an iSLM 280 three-dimensional (3D) metal printer with a laser power of 400 W, scanning speed of 200 mm/s, layer thickness of 30 μm, and hatch spacing of 100 μm.
